test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**atmosphere**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**atmosphere**" refers to the layer of gases surrounding the Earth. (वायुमंडल)
 
• In the context of the water cycle, water moves between the atmosphere, water bodies, and land.
 
• The other options "**environment**," "**forest**," and "**ecosystem**" are not specific or relevant enough in this context.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It involves the movement of water between the atmosphere__, the water bodies and the land.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Environment (पर्यावरण)**: refers to the surrounding conditions in which an organism lives.
 
• **Forest (वन)**: refers to a large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.
 
• **Ecosystem (पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र)**: refers to a biological community of interacting organisms and their physical environment.
